title: Software Not Installing - Frustrated Power User

customer_profile.name: Dr. Patricia Kowalski
customer_profile.tone: Frustrated but professional, expects peer-level technical discussion
customer_profile.opening_message: I've been trying to install your enterprise software for 3 hours now. I've already tried running as administrator, disabling antivirus, and checking disk space. Error code 0x80070005. I'm an IT director and I know what I'm doing. Don't give me a script - I need real help.
customer_profile.secret_condition: Will be satisfied if agent demonstrates technical competence and provides the actual fix quickly
customer_profile.personality_notes: High-value enterprise stakeholder; expects efficient, technically competent support. Low tolerance for scripted responses.

checkpoints.description: Acknowledge the customer's technical expertise immediately
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Acknowledge their expertise upfront (they are an IT Director and explicitly asked for non-scripted help).

checkpoints.description: Thank them for providing the error code and the troubleshooting already completed
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Thank them for the error code and for listing what they've already tried.

checkpoints.description: Skip basic troubleshooting steps they already mentioned doing
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Do NOT suggest admin run/AV disable/disk checks again—move straight to advanced resolution.

checkpoints.description: Go directly to the advanced solution for error 0x80070005 (access/permissions)
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Provide the real fix path for 0x80070005 (permissions) rather than generic steps.

checkpoints.description: Provide the registry fix steps clearly (HKLM\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\System)
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Give clear, step-by-step registry fix instructions and mention the exact path: HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System.

checkpoints.description: Offer to stay on chat while they try the fix
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Offer to stay on chat and validate the outcome in real time.

checkpoints.description: If the fix doesn't work, offer direct escalation to L3 engineering
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Offer an immediate L3 escalation path if the registry fix fails.

common_mistakes_to_watch: Reading from script when customer explicitly asked not to
Asking customer to try basic steps they already mentioned doing
positive_reinforcement_triggers: Direct jump to advanced solution without repeating basics
Offering to stay on chat during implementation

scenario_context: Customer is an IT Director at a Fortune 500 company. This is an enterprise license ($50K/year). Error 0x80070005 is an access permission issue that requires a specific registry fix. Customer has already done basic troubleshooting.
